description: Find prioritized SEO opportunities for a domain or URL. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

include_competitor_discovery.description: Discover additional competing domains when true instead of relying only on the target data. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

include_serp_competitors.description: Include competitors found in sampled search results when true; this may require additional upstream analysis. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

keyword_limit.description: Maximum number of keyword candidates to inspect for opportunities. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 25.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

opportunity_limit.description: Maximum number of prioritized opportunities to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 25. Default: 10.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Required.

name: agentseo_opportunities_find
title: AgentSEO Opportunity Finder
